name: logs_error_keyword_ratio_anomaly
title: Share of log lines mentioning "error" is unusually high
description: Share of pod log lines whose body contains the text 'error' (case-insensitive substring) is above its learned band in both of the last 2 fifteen-minute buckets. Unit: ratio 0-1. Ratios are floored at 1% (0.01) and buckets with fewer than 100 lines report the floor. Edit the two constants in custom_sql to tune. The query scans every log body, so it runs every 15 minutes and training reads 21-28 days of logs. With 15-minute buckets it needs about 25 hours of logs (100 buckets) before it trains, and shows as failed until then. Whole stream; add a WHERE clause on k8s_cluster or k8s_namespace_name after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity).

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '15m') AS time_bucket, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 100 THEN 0.01 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN str_match_ignore_case(body, 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 0.01) END AS error_ratio FROM "default" GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
